description: This file defines an Android Fragment called AccountFragment, which manages the user interface for account authentication status, sign-in/sign-out actions, and cloud sync toggling. It interacts with configuration settings and a sync manager to reflect and modify the user's authentication and sync state.

classes.name: AccountFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that displays account authentication status, allows sign-in and sign-out, and toggles cloud sync preferences.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the layout for the fragment and initializes view references.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components, assigns click listeners, and updates UI based on sync and authentication state.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Nullifies view references to prevent memory leaks.
